interface.title: DockForgeAI — resource-aware molecular docking, virtual screening and hit-prioritization platform
interface.field: Computational structural biology / structure-based drug discovery (cheminformatics)
interface.stage_of_work: Analysis and reporting of already-computed results: protocol validation, interaction inspection, candidate ranking and export
interface.what_it_is_for: Reviewing a validated HIV-1 protease (1HSG/MK1) redocking case — RMSD against the crystal pose, catalytic Asp25 contacts, a small screening shortlist and its consensus ranking — and packaging the evidence as offline reports and data files. A separate machine-learning activity-classifier benchmark (XAI pages) sits alongside it and does not feed the consensus ranking.

data.note: All pages read precomputed artifacts shipped with the repo (1HSG/MK1 docking poses, interaction records, a 3-compound demo screening library, a 2-row consensus shortlist, and ML/XAI tables under data/model_v2). Nothing is uploaded or recomputed in the UI; the only compute button, 'Generate PDF and HTML reports', fails here with ModuleNotFoundError: matplotlib (screens/045), while the already-generated PDF/HTML still download fine.

tree.general: Decide whether a computational prediction pipeline is trustworthy, then use it to rank candidates and package the evidence; separately, gauge how far a learned activity classifier's benchmark can be trusted
tree.specific: Confirm AutoDock Vina reproduces the crystallographic MK1 pose for 1HSG, inspect the catalytic-site interactions, review the screened shortlist's consensus ranking, export the offline report and data files, and skim the XAI classifier benchmark and its external validation
